name: Varesa
notes: KQM and Game8 agree on 4pc Long Night's Oath first and Obsidian Codex second, ATK% Sands, an Electro DMG Goblet (KQM: then ATK%), a CRIT Circlet, Normal Attack > Burst > Skill (her plunging attacks are the damage), and Vivid Notions first (KQM lists it with Reliquary of Truth, Kagura's Verity and Crane's Echoing Call; Game8's alternatives overlap). Marechaussee Hunter (only reliable with Furina) and Desert Pavilion Chronicle are KQM's. The damage line is her plunging attack, which is on the physical curve (74.6% to 147.4%, ratio 1.976), so the table is physical although the Flying Kick (345.1% to 621.2%) and her Normal Attacks are on the elemental curve. Goals are Game8's: ATK 2,000-3,000 (upper end), CR 50-60 (60), CD 180 or above, ER 120-145 with another Electro unit (190-200 solo); KQM agrees with ER 120-145 for double Electro and 195-200 solo. Partners are inferred (Electro for the Nightsoul and Electro-Charged teams, Hydro for Furina, Pyro); the sources give no team list.
